title: CSS custom-property resolver
prompt:
Implement resolve in theme.py for the design-token build step.

resolve(tokens, name) returns the final value for a custom property.

tokens maps property names (with the leading '--') to raw values. Values may
reference other properties with var(--name) or var(--name, fallback).

Rules:
- Resolve chains until a concrete value is reached.
- Use the fallback when the referenced name is unknown.
- A cycle raises ValueError, mentioning 'cycle'.
- An unknown name with no fallback, or the name itself unknown, raises KeyError.
- Whitespace around the resolved value is stripped.
- A value may contain several var() references; each is substituted.
- Nested fallbacks are supported, e.g. var(--a, var(--b, red)).

Only theme.py should change.
